findingConvergence.resolution: Result admission freshness now requires the ActionPackage lifecycle state to exactly equal the exact current Action lifecycle state at admission, with both sides restricted to prepared|resumed. Focused negative proof rejects prepared-package/resumed-current and resumed-package/prepared-current without adding replay infrastructure.

proposalReadiness.statement: The sole 037 blocking finding is closed by a bounded package/current lifecycle-state freshness invariant; no known contract-changing unknown remains in the authorized ActionPackage/Result-admission scope.

limitations: This is Author revise-explore completion, not Reviewer approval or Verification PASS.
The freshness proof is an exploration-only model using current repository validators; production admission code is intentionally not implemented in Explore.
PackageId/ResultId, nonce/replay registries, locking, Policy and resume/terminal orchestration remain outside this revision.
Raw proof files are execution-local and excluded from stable transfer.
